subject: Short-notice throughput uplift + one-time overrun reconciliation
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@lumenpath.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@lumenpath.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T08:12:00Z
Subject: Immediate request: short-notice throughput uplift for pilot

Hi Vivek —

Quick context: LumenPath is kicking off a controlled Black Friday pilot for a subset of customers next week and our traffic forecast doubled overnight after a retention test. We expect a concentrated 36-hour spike starting 2026-11-25 00:00 UTC. Current committed throughput will be insufficient.

Can Redwood provide a short-notice throughput uplift (temporary quota increase / rate limit raise) for that window and a one-off reconciliation/true-up for the overrun? We prefer a simple commercial path: provisional headroom for the 36-hour window + a reconciled invoice after the event.

Attachments: I attached a short forecast (CSV) and a one-page campaign brief.

Requirements:
- Immediate headroom for 36 hours starting 2026-11-25 00:00 UTC
- Max sustained QPS increase target: ~3x current baseline (peaks for short bursts)
- Clear one-off true-up after event; LumenPath will sign a PO for the uplift if pricing is agreed

Can you confirm feasibility and a one-time commercial figure this morning? We need to commit to internal stakeholders.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Product Operations
LumenPath
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@lumenpath.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Immediate request: short-notice throughput uplift for pilot

Thanks Maya — looping in Karthik and Jordan to scope commercial and operational feasibility. I included Grace for billing visibility.

High level asks for the internal team:
- Confirm if we can provision a temporary quota window for 2026-11-25 00:00 UTC -> 2026-11-26 12:00 UTC (36 hours) with 3x sustained scaling and short sub-minute bursts at up to 5x baseline.
- If yes, propose a one-time price for the uplift and an expected true-up invoice cadence (net 30 / net 45).
- Any constraints for Dedicated vs Hosted routing that might change cost assumptions.

Maya — if you can share the forecast file (CSV) and a preferred PO workflow, that will speed approvals.

Vivek
VP, Customer Success (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@lumenpath.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Immediate request: short-notice throughput uplift for pilot

On feasibility: runtime team confirms we can route a provisional headroom pool for LumenPath's hosted tenancy for the 36-hour window with automated fallback to a compatible model variant if we hit capacity. We can enforce a hard cap to protect other customers.

Commercial proposal (one-off, simple structure) — propose both options so customer can choose:

Option A — Provisional Headroom + True-up
- One-time provisional headroom reservation fee: $18,000 for the 36-hour guaranteed uplift (covers reserved GPU/window and priority routing).
- Overrun true-up: actual consumed tokens above committed baseline billed at 1.5x standard hosted overage rate; reconciliation invoice after the event with net-30 payment.
- Requires signed PO by 2026-11-10 to ensure capacity reservation.

Option B — Pay-as-you-go uplift (no reservation)
- No upfront fee, higher overrun premium: 2.0x standard hosted overage rate for any usage above baseline during the event window.
- No capacity guarantee; best-effort routing.

We recommend Option A for predictable latency and capacity guarantees given the concentrated window.

Operational notes:
- We need LumenPath to provide the campaign forecast CSV (peak QPS per hour) and a technical contact for a quick connectivity check before 2026-11-20.
- If they have Dedicated capacity already, pricing may change (lower per-token overrun multiplier) — Jordan can confirm routing specifics.

Maya — attaching a sample PO template and the forecast stub you sent earlier (please update if there are additional bursts).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: lumenpath_blackfriday_forecast.csv, provisional_headroom_po_template.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@lumenpath.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Immediate request: short-notice throughput uplift for pilot

Thanks — operationally we can support Option A. A couple quick clarifications before we lock pricing and PO timing:

1) Hard cap configuration: we will provision the headroom pool and enforce a tenant-level hard cap to avoid cross-tenant impact. If LumenPath expects sustained microbursts >7x baseline, flag that now.

2) Rollback policy: after the 36-hour window we revert quotas to baseline automatically; any queued requests will be throttled or routed to the lower-priority tier per agreed policy.

3) Invoice path: Grace — LumenPath prefers a single reconciled invoice post-event. Can you confirm we can do net-30? Also note accounting will want the PDF PO attached to the invoice.

Maya — if you're good with Option A ($18,000 reservation + 1.5x overrun rate, net-30, PO by 2026-11-10) please send signed PO and the detailed hourly forecast by 2026-11-03 so our stack ops can run a staging load check. We'll stand up the headroom once PO is received.

If LumenPath prefers Option B we can toggle but cannot guarantee capacity.

Jordan Blake
Director, Service Delivery
Redwood Inference
